title: Vaporesso Vibe Pod Vape Kit
description: The Vaporesso Vibe Pod Vape Kit is a compact and stylish refillable pod device that balances pocket-friendly design with impressive battery life and performance. This stealthy pod kit is ideal for vapers who enjoy MTL (mouth-to-lung) or RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping, with smart coil technology that automatically adjusts the output power for your preferred style. Despite its slim profile, the Vibe houses a powerful built-in 1100mAh battery that supports fast USB-C charging and delivers up to 24W of power. The device features a simple one-button interface with optional draw activation and a clear LED screen that displays both power and battery levels. The included 2ml Vibe Smart Pod features dual mesh coils with resistances of 0.6ohm and 0.8ohm, automatically switching between Eco Mode (12W–14W) and Power Mode (20W–24W) to suit your vaping needs. Vaporesso’s Hyperflow mesh technology, combined with flax cotton wicking, delivers excellent flavour and reliable coil performance with both nicotine salt and 50/50 e-liquids . With its striking design, responsive Smart Pod platform, and long-lasting battery, the Vaporesso Vibe Nano is a versatile and stylish pod vape kit that’s built for smooth, everyday vaping. Browse our extensive selection of vape juice and find a delicious companion for your kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
